title: Is Your Diwali Food Coma Actually the Sweets?
description:
Diwali food coma: is it really the sweets? A sleep lab gave people high-fat, high-carb or mixed meals and found no difference in how fast they fell asleep. What did matter was eating an actual solid meal versus the same amount of water. Cyto breaks it down from Scarborough, live from the 6ix.

A second study blocked the immune messenger IL-1 and people felt less tired after a big high-fat, high-carb meal. So the couch nap after the feast is a full stomach plus immune signals, not just the mithai. Both studies were small and in men only, so take it as a fun clue, not the final word.

Sources (via PubMed):
Orr et al., Physiol Behav 1997 — https://doi.org/10.1016/s0031-9384(97)00012-7
Lehrskov et al., Mol Metab 2018 — https://doi.org/10.1016/j.molmet.2018.04.001 (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29705519/)

Not medical advice. Happy Diwali from Scarborough!
